note: Expected probe facts for the synthetic fixtures produced by generate.sh. Durations in ms, dimensions in px. 'decodeWithXerror' is the exit expectation of `ffmpeg -xerror -i <file> -f null -`: 0 = clean full decode, 'nonzero' = the decoder must report an error (truncated/invalid data). Limits referenced here are PENDING_D3 test placeholders (300000 ms, 1920x1080), not approved values.

s3-vfr.mp4.note: variable frame rate; duration shorter than 4 s because frames were dropped

s4-hevc.mp4.note: generated only when the generator has libx265; the pinned LGPL build has no HEVC decoder, so decodeWithXerror is nonzero there and the validator must reject with video-codec-not-allowed

s5-truncated.mp4.note: faststart moov is intact so ffprobe succeeds; the truncation is only detected by decoding with -xerror

s6-duration-over-limit-300500ms.mp4.note: +1 frame at 2 fps = +500 ms; finer granularity is not meaningful for a container-level duration limit

s6-res-over-limit-1922x1080.mp4.note: H.264 needs even dimensions, so the smallest over-limit width is 1922

s6-metadata-tags.mp4.note: the normalizing remux must remove every one of these

s9-wrong-container.webm.note: the pinned build has only the mov demuxer, so it cannot open WebM (probe fails); a full generator build can
